items.text: AS YOU BREAK THROUGH THE DOOR INTO A WELL FITTED APARTMENT, TWO GIANTS COME LUMBERING UP TO YOU. YOU TURN TO FACE THEM.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 'HEY, WHAT DO YOU THINK YOU'RE DOING?'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'OH... OKAY.' AND WITH THAT THEY LEAVE.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: UNDER A LOOSE STONE YOU FIND SOME TREASURE.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU ENTER A LATRINE. THE LACK OF BAD SMELL GIVES YOU A GENERAL IDEA OF THE LEVEL OF SANITATION PRACTICED BY THE INHABITANTS OF THE AREA.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AS YOU OPEN THE DOOR A BUCKET OF SAND THAT WAS PROPPED ABOVE THE DOOR FALLS.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: BEFORE YOU OPEN THE DOOR ALL THE WAY, YOU NOTICE A BUCKET ABOVE THE DOOR. YOU KICK THE DOOR OPEN LETTING THE BUCKET FALL HARMLESSLY TO THE GROUND.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AS YOU ENTER THE ROOM YOU SEE SOME SLEEPING GIANTS.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AS YOU SNEAK TOWARD THEM A LOOSE BOARD CREAKS. THE GIANTS GET TO THEIR FEET SHAKING THE SLEEP FROM THEIR EYES.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU FIND SOME TREASURE.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU HEAR A DEEP VOICE, 'HEY, THAT'S THEM GUYS WHO TRIED TO BUST IN!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: YOU HEAR A DEEP VOICE,'THIEF! YOU STOLE FROM LORDBANE!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: A VOLLEY OF BOULDERS ARE THROWN AT YOU...
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: CADORNA HANDS YOU A SLIP OF PAPER AND WHISPERS, 'HERE IS TODAY'S GATE PASSWORD.'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: WHAT PASSWORD DO YOU GIVE?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration ending with a direct question

items.text: 'ALL RIGHT, THEN. PASS!' AND WITH THAT THE GATES SWING OPEN AND YOU PASS THROUGH THE GATE.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'HAH! HAH! YOU'RE DUMB! THAT'S NOT THE PASSWORD!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: YOU ARE IN A DESERTED BUILDING. THERE ARE NOTHING BUT VERY LARGE COBWEBS HERE.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AS YOU PUSH THE DOOR OPEN THE CEILING CAVES IN.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: TWO GIANTS COME BOUNDING OUT OF A DOORWAY. ONE STAYS BY THE DOOR.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 'TELL ME PASSWORD OR I KILL YOU. NOW!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'OKAY, BUT NO HANGING AROUND.'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: THE GIANT HESITATES, 'WHO SENT YOU?'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'SORRY ME NOT KNOW! JUST DOING JOB! YOU GO NOW.'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: THEY RAISE THEIR CLUBS. 'YOU STOLE FROM LORD BANE'S TEMPLE!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'WRONG ANSWER, DINNER!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: TWO GIANTS STAND BARRING YOUR WAY.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: BEFORE YOU IS A WELL FILLED WITH WATER.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE WATER LOOKS COLD AND DEEP. DO YOU WANT TO DIVE IN?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration ending with a direct question

items.text: YOU SWIM DOWN UNTIL YOU FEEL YOUR PULSE BEATING IN YOUR EARS. YOU DON'T REACH THE BOTTOM.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: ASIDE FROM A LAYER OF MUD, YOU DON'T FIND ANYTHING.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: TRY AGAIN?
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THIS IS A SMALL CELL. CHAINED TO THE WALL IS A MAN BEATEN TO WITHIN AN INCH OF HIS LIFE. AS YOU OPEN THE DOOR HE LOOKS UP AND YOU FEEL A SHOCK... THE MAN IS PORPHYRYS CADORNA.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 'IN THE NAME OF CHANTUA, HELP ME, PLEASE! BY ALL THAT'S MERCIFUL HELP ME.' HE BEGINS TO COUGH.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'WAIT!' HE SHRIEKS. 'I KNOW HOW TO GET THROUGH THE MAIN GATES. I CAN HELP YOU.'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: WITH A QUICK STROKE YOU RELEASE HIM FROM THIS PAIN... TO ALL THE PAIN TO COME.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 'WAIT DON'T LEAVE ME HERE. IF YOU DO I'LL RAISE THE ALARM.'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'I KNOW THE WAY THROUGH THE HEDGE... LEFT RIGHT RIGHT... FOR CHANTUA'S SAKE! DON'T LEAVE ME!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: YOU LEAVE. BEHIND YOU ARE HIS SCREAMS, 'INTRUDERS! INTRUDERS!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'THANK YOU! THANK YOU! I JUST THOUGHT THAT THE POOL WAS HERE! THERE WAS NOWHERE ELSE TO GO! I HAVE NOWHERE TO GO. TAKE ME WITH YOU?'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech
